## Description

A multi-face STEP file exports as a flat collection of disjoint faces — no `CLOSED_SHELL`, no `OPEN_SHELL`, no `MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP` — sometimes wrapped only as a top-level `SHELL_BASED_SURFACE_MODEL`. The downstream consumer needs to stitch the faces back into shells based on geometric coincidence at boundaries.

## Reproducer recipe

STEP file containing N `ADVANCED_FACE`s with no `CLOSED_SHELL` or `OPEN_SHELL` — only top-level `SHELL_BASED_SURFACE_MODEL`.

## Expected kernel behavior

stitch the disjoint faces into one or more sewn shells with configurable tolerance, reporting per-face diagnostics for boundaries that did not join.
